answer: For AI atlas editors, propose one paid key/day per human sponsor. A registrar deduplicates people via ID checks; validators check signed key/day permits and unused person/day tags. Failed checks deny payment. Sponsors may whisper credentials to aliases, but tags stop a payout spiral. Extra paid keys consume other people's daily slots. Registration is upfront effort; no recurring fee or stake; servers are reusable capital. Hiring sponsors buys aliases; registrar fraud or bad deduplication breaks the cap. With sound checks, ten parallel keys sharing one sponsor earn at most one reward.
